stop if the next route would execute measured rollout without concrete overlay and reset evidence

route to branch synthesis if adapter evidence is broad or inconclusive
stop for user review if claim boundaries are violated

success_criteria: M2458 summary, work items, static checks, reset checks, overlay requirements, guardrails, and claim boundary are audited
a bounded concrete overlay design, synthesis, or stop route is selected
no reset rollout scenario-redesign execution repair training ranking winner or verdict claim is made

M2459 executes scenario redesign, repair, or training

decision_rule: M2459 passes if it audits M2458 and selects a bounded concrete overlay design, synthesis, or stop route without reset, rollout, scenario redesign execution, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, or verdict claims.
